annotations.text:
Four directions, not four shades of one. Pick an axis, then I build it out into the full lockup set.

All four animate — smoke drifts, neon flickers, the sunburst turns, the stamp ring rotates. Motion is off automatically for anyone with reduced-motion set.

Green is a tweak chip on every artboard.

A — HAZE
Premium nightlife. Closest to your events business. Archivo Black, rising smoke, breathing halo.
Tradeoff: least overtly 420.

B — NEON
Sign shop. Highest energy, reads across a dark room. Real tube glow, one flickering numeral.
Tradeoff: needs dark backgrounds to work.

C — GROOVE
The authentic 420 lineage — 1970s counterculture. DynaPuff, sunburst, arced type, cream accent.
Tradeoff: playful, less premium.

D — STAMP
Badge/seal. Protest Guerrilla type. Most versatile at small sizes — merch, stickers, embroidery.
Tradeoff: most conventional.
